body: I have a lot of classes with this kind of code (lambda's referring to a classmethod) so I'm "voting" to raise the priority on this bug.

Looks like it, thanks for bringing it up. The code that handles this verification is kinda messy and it seems that it misses a lot of cases, I would rewrite it completely, if I'd have time, to use something more structured than it currently is.
Any progress on fixing this issue?

FWIW, just hit this linting the line `_compose = lambda f, g: lambda x: f(g(x))`

```
E: 54,34: Undefined variable 'f' (undefined-variable)
E: 54,36: Undefined variable 'g' (undefined-variable)
```
